verdict.rationale: The evidence shows backend SDKs connecting with backend tokens and an `isEnabled` check in application code. It also describes Unleash Edge as a caching read-replica layer that serves thousands of SDKs and evaluates targeting data inside the Edge node. Together these imply a cached ruleset, but no item states that server SDKs evaluate flags in-process with no network call per check. Missing for 10: explicit docs that server SDKs fetch and cache the ruleset and evaluate locally, any latency or microsecond-decision claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
